subject: computer-science
title: Digital Wellbeing: Foundations
welcome_lead: Being online should feel good — let's learn the habits that keep it that way.
meta_desc: KS3 e-safety: balance, screen time, healthy habits, footprint.
final_note: Use the screen; don't let it use you.

concepts.def: All the data you leave online.
How long you spend on devices.
Controls over who sees your data.
Being healthy in body and mind.
A limit you set for yourself.

walkthroughs.body_html: Devices are tools. Set times for school, friends, sleep. Even short breaks every 30 minutes help eyes and posture.
Posts, likes and searches build your digital footprint. Future you (and future employers) can see it. Post like everyone is reading.
Turn off non-essential notifications. Your phone interrupts less and your focus improves.
